worked_solution:
For a surface $S$ with parametrization $r(u,v)$ for $(u,v)\in D,$ the surface integral of a scalar function $f$ over $S$ is given by

$$
{∬}_{S}f(x,y,z)\,\text{d}S={∬}_{D}f(r(u,v))‖{r}_{u}^{′}\times {r}_{v}^{′}‖\text{d}A.
$$

Notice that we are told that the norm of the fundamental vector product is

$$
‖{r}_{u}^{′}\times {r}_{v}^{′}‖=\sqrt{3}.
$$

Next, we substitute the coordinate expressions of $r(u,v)$ into $f(x,y,z):$

$$
\begin{aligned}f(r(u,v)) & =6xyz\,{|}_{x=u\,y=u+v\,z=v} \\  & =6(u)(u+v)(v) \\  & =6({u}^{2}v+u{v}^{2})\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our surface integral can be written as 

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{S}f(x,y,z)\,\text{d}S & ={∬}_{D}f(r(u,v))‖{r}_{u}^{′}\times {r}_{v}^{′}‖\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}\,6({u}^{2}v+u{v}^{2})\cdot \sqrt{3}\,\text{d}A \\  & =6\sqrt{3}{∬}_{D}\,({u}^{2}v+u{v}^{2})\,\text{d}A \\  & =6\sqrt{3}{\int }_{0}^{1}({\int }_{0}^{1}({u}^{2}v+u{v}^{2})\text{d}u)\text{d}v \\  & =6\sqrt{3}{\int }_{0}^{1}{[\frac{{u}^{3}v}{3}+\frac{{u}^{2}{v}^{2}}{2}]}_{0}^{1}\,\text{d}v \\  & =6\sqrt{3}{\int }_{0}^{1}(\frac{v}{3}+\frac{{v}^{2}}{2})\,\text{d}v \\  & =6\sqrt{3}{[\frac{{v}^{2}}{6}+\frac{{v}^{3}}{6}]}_{0}^{1} \\  & =6\sqrt{3}(\frac{1}{6}+\frac{1}{6}) \\  & =2\sqrt{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

∬Sf(x,y,z)dS=∬Df(r(u,v))‖ru′×rv′‖dA.

Notice that we are told that the norm of the fundamental vector product is

‖ru′×rv′‖=3.

Next, we substitute the coordinate expressions of r(u,v) into f(x,y,z):

f(r(u,v))=6xyz|x=uy=u+vz=v=6(u)(u+v)(v)=6(u2v+uv2)

Therefore, our surface integral can be written as

∬Sf(x,y,z)dS=∬Df(r(u,v))‖ru′×rv′‖dA=∬D6(u2v+uv2)⋅3dA=63∬D(u2v+uv2)dA=63∫01(∫01(u2v+uv2)du)dv=63∫01[u3v3+u2v22]01dv=63∫01(v3+v22)dv=63[v26+v36]01=63(16+16)=23.
